content:
“Better than PERFECT!”— Watoga Estates signage

The **Watoga Estates** are a building complex in the Appalachian city of Watoga.

The primary housing complex of Watoga, the estates were once home to the elite inhabitants who could afford to buy property in the city of the future. Fitted with all the modern amenities, including a topside pool and bar, direct monorail access, underground parking lots, and a fleet of robotic staff to cater to every need of the owners, they are now a derelict ruin.

Stretching across the southwestern end of Watoga, the estates are largely ruined and inaccessible, particularly the underground parking lot and the suites themselves. Player characters can only access the external parts, such as the topside bar and pool in the center of the area, the monorail station to the northwest (with random junk items inside), and the underground passageway beneath.

The upper floors are accessible via numerous stairwells in the southeastern part of town. The bar and pool area contains a wall-mounted Safe and a potential Vault-Tec bobblehead spawn behind the counter, with a Steamer Trunk nearby. The underground passage near the voting machines also contains a potential Magazine spawn.

- My Reputation - Holotape, at the bottom of the dry pool on the roof.
- Protestors - Holotape, on top of an overturned chair by the pool.
- Sideshow Snallygaster - Part 1 - Holotape, on the bar counter on the roof.
- That boy - Holotape, on a table in the lobby on the first floor.
- "That boy" - Holotape, on a table, next to the pool on the roof.
- Watoga Residents - Holotape, on a table on the third floor, overlooking a short bridge.
- Your reputation - Holotape, next to a trash can in the lobby on the first floor.
- Potential Vault-Tec bobblehead - At the outdoor diner on the upper level, on top of shelves behind the bar counter.
- Three potential Magazines:
 - On the roof.
 - On a table on the third floor of Watoga Estates.
 - On a seat on the eastern half of the monorail by the estates.
- Potential Armor Mod - On the roof, atop one metal barrel of three barrels clustered together.
- Potential Power Armor Mod - At the bottom of the main staircase leading to the estates above, on a lower crate of three stacked.

The Watoga Estates appears in *Fallout 76*.

- Main entrance on the western site of the building
- Lobby
- That boy (left) and Your reputation (right)
- Signage on the eastern side of the complex
- Inner yard to the east
- Second floor
- Third floor
- Watoga Residents on the third floor
- Magazine spawn location on the third floor
- Roof with bar, lounge and swimming pool

- Mod spawn location on the roof
